rules: A placeholder, stub, mock, disconnected class or design document cannot count as IMPLEMENTED.
IMPLEMENTED requires existing implementation files and at least one acceptance test id that exists.
INTEGRATION_TESTED requires at least one integration test id and must be confirmed by workstream H (verified_by).
EMPIRICALLY_DEMONSTRATED / FAILED_EMPIRICALLY require evidence entries pointing at result files or ledger sections.
Do not weaken acceptance tests to make an incomplete implementation appear finished.

Engineering completion and scientific success are separate: FAILED_EMPIRICALLY is a valid, honest final status for an implemented, integrated capability whose experiment did not show the intended benefit.

Requirements from CAM_UNIFIED_SPEC_META_REWARDS.md and CAM_UNIFIED_SPEC_DOM.md are mandatory and are tracked here with the same evidence rules; `python -m superlearner.verify_completion` enforces them.
